claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The present class satisfies P1--P5 and MP without additional F-axioms; it is not the 1021-member F family and neither count logically entails the other. For instance the meet operation A→B=A∩B satisfies MP and the five axioms but fails conditional identity at proper antecedents, so it is outside the F class. No reverse inclusion is inferred: F-style laws do not formally impose MP, and the actual intersection or inclusion of the two classes on this particular carrier has not been counted here. The earlier chain result applies to linearly ordered carriers only.

value.rationale: The class P1--P5+MP is an independently motivated semantic boundary between unrestricted preconditionals and Heyting implication (which requires weak monotonicity). The finite-Boolean normal form is parameter-uniform; the exact three-atom census and Burnside orbit classification give a complete nontrivial finite benchmark not supplied by prior stronger-axiom tables. Counts extend a structural classification rather than an arbitrary subcase.
